root_cause.explanation: Snapshot getter returned only the selected id, which is unchanged on Hide, so useSyncExternalStore bailed out of re-render and the button label stayed stale ('Hide' after hidden=true). Store mutation/persist/notify were all correct.

fix.composite_snapshot: selectedEquipmentSnapshot() = `${id}|${hidden?hidden:visible}|${lifecycleState}` so the control re-renders on hide/lock change
fix.hide_show_toggle: hidden===false -> Hide -> setEquipmentVisibility(id,false); hidden===true -> Show -> setEquipmentVisibility(id,true)
fix.2d_hidden_marker: subdued/dashed, retains equipmentInstanceId, selectable, flagged hidden (not dropped)

test_change_note: build1bPlan2d.test.ts 'projects visible equipment envelopes and skips hidden ones' updated to the EVI-MA-02E §9 doctrine (hidden equipment is projected WITH a hidden flag, not dropped). Not a weakening: asserts both equipment present + the hidden one flagged + equipmentCount 2.
manual_acceptance_steps: Select KIUBE; if hidden control shows [Fit][Show][Unlock][Delete disabled]
Click Show -> KIUBE reappears; button -> Hide immediately
Click Hide -> disappears; button -> Show immediately (no refresh)
While hidden attempt overlapping placement -> still rejected (collision reserved)
Unlock -> Delete -> KIUBE gone from 3D, 2D, card, floating control
stop_condition: Automated verification passes; dev server on 3000. STOP. Await manual EVI-MA-02E acceptance. Do not start PTS/RTHS/MRT animation/Build 2.
